mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM proj_task_business_link WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND task_id = #{query.taskId} AND unlinked_at IS NULL AND active_marker = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM proj_project_task_execution_contract c JOIN proj_project_task t ON t.id = c.project_task_id AND t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND t.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND c.project_task_id = #{query.taskId} AND c.current_marker = 1 AND c.effective_to IS NULL AND c.deleted = b'0' AND t.deleted = b'0'
